title: Mercury Script Hub
features:
Just a random script hub with a really nice UI I've been working on for a while. It's been 5 months since the last update but I finally provoked. I hope to keep this project going for a while. So let me know what you think I should add!
Changelog:
- New icons for most of the tabs
- New default theme (Serika)
- New tab (Admin scripts)
- More scripts added to all tabs
- New Scriptblox thumbnail (I actually made this lol)
- And probably more I'm forgetting about

One thing, if the script doesn't work when you first execute it, thats normal. Just execute it again and you'll be good.
